attributes.cardDescription: Contractor profile: name, contact, contract status, billable rate, VAT ID, and invoice frequency
attributes.readMe:
# Contractor

## Summary
A contractor resource linked from Offers and Projects. Extends PersonBase with `contractStatus` (active | inactive | terminated), `billableRate` (hourly/daily rate in dollars), `vatId` (for invoicing), and `invoiceFrequency` (monthly | quarterly | annually). `title` is computed from `name`, defaulting to "Contractor".

## Import
```ts
import { Contractor } from './contractor';
```

## Usage — three or more ways this is used

**1. As the external resource pool.** Contractors are linked from Offers as alternative hiring paths — when a requisition is filled via contract labor instead of permanent hire, the offer points at a Contractor instance instead of creating an Employee record.

**2. As the invoicing source.** The `billableRate`, `invoiceFrequency`, and `vatId` drive invoice generation; the billing system queries contractors by `invoiceFrequency` to batch-generate monthly/quarterly/annual invoices.

**3. As the project staffing model.** Projects can link contractors for specialized work (QA, DevOps, security) separate from the employee roster; the project dashboard shows billable cost alongside headcount.

## Template Usage
Isolated displays contact info, rate & terms, and contract status in a 2-column layout (main + side panel). Embedded is a one-liner with avatar, name, and status pill. Fitted degrades from a card showing name and rate through progressively smaller tiers. Atom is just the name.

## Reuse notes
Contractors reuse the PersonBase avatar/initials/name infrastructure so they render consistently across the app. Contract status colors (active=green, inactive=amber, terminated=red) follow the same v1 pattern as Employee and Candidate statuses.

**Non-goals:** Contract documents/file storage (separate document management); billable hours tracking (belongs in time-tracking integration); benefit eligibility (Contractors are out-of-scope for benefits).
